item.coloph: bdag 'dra gar dbang rad Na gling pa'am bdud 'dul gsang sngags grags pa ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma de nyid gnas chen shel le rgya gar (skar) gyi gter gnas nas gter du spyan drangs shing slar las ldan bla grwa du ma nas bka' yis bskul ngor shing phag zla tshes bzang por shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur te drung yig pa ni tshul khrims blo ldan dang yi ge'i byed po 'gru bon g.yung drung dar rgyas pas bgyis pas thams cad re dogs kyi gol sa chod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
